title: stipa pennata subsp. lejophylla
intro: Stipa pennata subsp. lejophylla, commonly known as Red Fescue, is a type of grass that is native to certain regions of Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Red Fescue include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and acting as an expectorant to help relieve respiratory problems. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
